name: Achilles Coffee
notes: Restaurant's own Shopify site, full priced text menu server-rendered on the page (not the /products.json storefront, which sells retail coffee bean bags -- that was checked and correctly excluded as merchandise, not the drinks/food menu). Achilles is a small local multi-cafe chain (B St @ The Rey, Gaslamp 4th+J, Park 12, Solana Beach, Carmel Valley); this single 'On The Menu' page is shared across locations with no location-specific pricing found, so it is treated as the current menu for the Park 12 branch. Address for the Park 12 location (100 Park Plz, San Diego) confirmed via web search matches the batch's 100 Park Plaza. Two-price items (small/large or hot/iced) recorded as two rows. Deliberately excluded the 'Single Origin Coffees and blends' retail section (bagged beans sold by weight, e.g. 'Ethiopia Bekele Kechara Natural Murago From $26.00 USD') as retail merchandise, not food/drink menu items. One item, 'Eggs Scramble $13.00', carries an obviously wrong site-side copy-pasted description (identical to the Prospect St. smoothie's text) -- recorded the name and price only, description left blank rather than publishing the mismatched text.
